findings.description: __aexit__ discards the actual exception info and calls self.__exit__(None, None, None), so exceptions raised inside an async with block are not passed to the retry logic.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an exception is raised inside an `async with` block using this object. The mechanism: __aexit__ receives exc_type/exc_value/traceback but passes None for all of them to __exit__, so the sync __exit__ sees no exception and treats the block as successful (setting result None and returning None), suppressing the error. Impact: the exception is silently swallowed rather than being recorded for retry or propagated to the caller, producing silently wrong results.
